description: Series resistors on the MIDI out's tip and ring, CA-033 Figure 1's 5 V row
notes: TWO (R-MIDI-T on the tip, R-MIDI-R on the ring), equal, because the loop is symmetric: each is RA when its line is the source and RC when it is the sink, so Type A or B is firmware's [ds datasheets/connectors/MIDI-CA-033-ELECTRICAL-SPEC-UPDATE-2014.pdf p.3: VTX +5 V +/-10 %, RA 220 ohm 5 % 0.25 W, RC 220 ohm 5 % 0.25 W]. 0.25 W: a short of a line to the sleeve is 5.0 V / 209 ohm = 23.9 mA and 0.12 W, and keeps U-LVLSHIFT inside its 25 mA continuous rating. 1206 for the 0.25 W. MPN by UNI-ROYAL's scheme, 1206W4J0221T5E; the LCSC code is open, to read off JLC's stock at order time
